Artizen mechanics clarified: matching tied only to artifact purchases, boosts only drive weekly cash-prize fund drives — coordinate boosts + funds within a single high-matching drive rather than spending randomly (Luiz holds ~600k boost points). Season funds release ~January with a reimbursement model for contributors. Discourse migration underway to Hetzner self-host (<$10/mo, from ~$100/mo; ~$80-90/mo saved) — blocker is billing owner Matt requesting the full backup from the current managed provider; Luiz has a draft and tries as admin first. Budget: no long-term treasury earmarking, route surplus through Artizen, outcome-driven not admin-task-driven, optional ~$500 working-group hedge; Karma GAP low priority, prioritize GG23 + poll data synthesis (Afo leads). Compensation stays flexible/trust-based (track hours); Luiz OK with reduced/no comp for his activity reports. Regen Commons stalled (leadership stepped back, ~$5k left, Foundation-join proposal stuck) — RC does not fully fold in; individuals still apply for membership.
